symptom: PC in VLAN 10 gets IP but cannot ping another VLAN
evidence: PC has 192.168.10.10/24, gateway 192.168.10.1. Switch shows Fa0/1 in VLAN 10. Router has no subinterface for VLAN 10.

symptom: PC cannot communicate with another PC in same VLAN
evidence: show vlan brief shows the access port assigned to VLAN 20 while the peer is in VLAN 10.

symptom: Trunk traffic for VLAN 30 fails
evidence: show interfaces trunk shows VLAN 30 is not allowed on the trunk.
expected_fault: VLAN 30 missing from trunk allowed list

symptom: New VLAN hosts have no connectivity
evidence: show vlan brief does not list VLAN 40.

symptom: PC receives IP but cannot reach local gateway
expected_fault: Default gateway is outside the PC subnet

symptom: Only one PC cannot reach remote networks
evidence: show ip route is correct; PC configuration shows mask 255.255.0.0 instead of 255.255.255.0.

symptom: Hosts in subnet cannot reach router
evidence: Router G0/0 is 192.168.50.1/24 but the PCs use gateway 192.168.60.1.

symptom: PC self-assigns 169.254.x.x address
evidence: show ip dhcp binding is empty and the DHCP pool is missing a network statement.

symptom: Some DHCP clients work, others do not
evidence: show ip dhcp pool shows 100% utilization.

symptom: Remote VLAN clients do not receive DHCP addresses
evidence: DHCP server is on VLAN 10; router subinterface for VLAN 20 lacks ip helper-address.

symptom: IP ping works but hostname ping fails
evidence: ping 8.8.8.8 succeeds; nslookup for server.local fails; PC DNS is blank.
expected_fault: DNS server not configured on client

symptom: Internal names resolve to wrong server
evidence: show run on DNS service contains an incorrect A record for server.local.

symptom: DNS server is unreachable
evidence: PC can ping gateway but cannot ping DNS server IP; ACL blocks UDP/TCP 53.

symptom: PC can reach gateway but not remote subnet
evidence: show ip route has no route for 10.20.0.0/16.

symptom: Remote network is unreachable after topology change
evidence: show ip route shows a stale static route pointing to a removed next hop.

symptom: OSPF neighbors do not form
evidence: show ip ospf neighbor is empty; interfaces are in different areas.

symptom: One direction of communication fails
evidence: show ip route on R2 has route to 10.10.0.0/24, but R1 has no route back to 10.20.0.0/24.

symptom: Web server cannot be reached but ping works
evidence: show access-lists shows an ACL denying TCP port 80 from the client subnet.

symptom: Guest users can access internal server
evidence: Guest ACL permits 10.0.0.0/8 instead of denying internal RFC1918 networks.

symptom: SSH access to router fails
evidence: show access-lists shows VTY ACL permits only 192.168.99.0/24; admin is in 192.168.10.0/24.

symptom: Inside host cannot reach internet
evidence: show ip nat translations is empty; inside interface is not marked ip nat inside.

symptom: Internet access works for one subnet only
evidence: show run shows NAT ACL matches 192.168.10.0/24 but users are in 192.168.20.0/24.
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not match client subnet

symptom: Port-forwarded web server is unreachable
evidence: show run lacks ip nat inside source static tcp mapping for port 80.

symptom: Wireless clients associate but cannot obtain IP
evidence: AP is connected to switch access port in VLAN 10 while wireless clients are mapped to VLAN 20.

symptom: Guest SSID can access corporate server
evidence: show vlan and ACL configuration places Guest SSID in the corporate VLAN.
expected_fault: Guest SSID mapped to corporate VLAN

symptom: Wireless client frequently disconnects
evidence: AP is configured on the same channel as a nearby AP; signal is weak.

symptom: Router link is down
evidence: show interfaces g0/1 reports administratively down.

symptom: Switch port shows down/down
evidence: show interfaces fa0/10 status reports notconnect; cable is not connected.

symptom: Hosts can reach some addresses but not others
evidence: PC uses /16 while network design requires /24; ARP occurs for unintended local addresses.

symptom: Intermittent connectivity between two hosts
evidence: show arp shows the same IP associated with different MAC addresses at different times.
